description:

Location: Oxford (OX44)

As Finance & Office Assistant, you will support the day-to-day running of the finance and administration functions within a small but busy business. Operating within a busy and collaborative environment, the business works closely with customers, suppliers and project teams, creating a varied and engaging finance role with broad responsibilities across the organisation.

This position offers the opportunity to gain exposure to a varied finance and administration function while becoming part of a collaborative and supportive team environment.

- Minimum 3 years' experience within a finance, accounts or office administration environment
- Relevant finance qualification, with experience using Sage
